accounting: Whole-process wall/CPU include launch, load, preparation, online, replay. Producer online interval is separate.
exit_observation_delay_note: Nominal 0-5 ms plus scheduling and poll-body delays; no strict bound under arbitrary scheduling
memory_limit_note: RLIMIT_AS allocation refusal may appear as nonzero/abort; no inference from exit code alone
peak_rss_source: Linux wait4(2) ru_maxrss KiB multiplied by 1024; exact child process
